description: Provides access to the dimensions of the nearest `v-layout` and the layout items registered in it.

exposed.getLayoutItem: Function that returns position and size information about a specific layout item.
exposed.layoutRect: Measured position and size of the layout container. `undefined` until the first measurement.
exposed.mainRect: Position and size information for the v-main area.
exposed.mainStyles: CSS styles applied to the v-main area.
